notes.title: Demo Patch
notes.notes:
Greetings, fellow Warriors!

After a day of fixing issues, we have released a little update for our demo.
The following stuff is out now: 

 Fixed an issue where Trinket slots where not properly displayed in 4-player multiplayer
 Fixed an issue when a player disconnects during a level up screen
 Fixed disconnect icons being displayed on all player portraits in the multiplayer lobby
 Fixed a sound issue with an enemy in Red Canyon
 Fixed an issue in multiplayer where progress was not properly tracked for the quests that unlock Secret Tincture, Prism & Persistence Rune for clients


We hope you enjoy the battle!

Your Warriors Team

notes.title: Major Demo Update!
notes.notes:
🚀 Royal Revolt Warriors - Major Demo Update: Online Multiplayer & 4-Player Co-op! 🎉  

Warriors, the time has come! The latest update for the Royal Revolt Warriors demo is here, and it’s our biggest one yet! ⚔️🔥 

🏆 Main Patch Notes:

🔹 Multiplayer Madness!
- We’ve enabled experimental 2-4 player online multiplayer via Steam Netplay!  
- Play with friends locally, online, or even mix and match both!  

🔹 Brand New Warrior!
- Added "Moe the Monk" incl. his ability and weapon enchantment.

🔹 New Warrior Abilities!
- Christa: "Berserk" – Unleash a furious attack speed boost!  
- Umberto: "Decoy" – Lure enemies in with a deadly trap that explodes based on their max HP.  
- Moe: "Cheers!" – Sacrifice HP to buff your and your allies’ damage!  
- Sam: "Satyrical Symphony" – A soothing melody that heals all nearby allies.  

🔹 New Weapons & Enchantments!
- "Tempest Rod" plus its "Storm Bringer" enchantment. 🌩️  
- "Valkyrie Spear" (Enchantment coming soon!).  
- "Gobbotech Mines" (Explosions incoming!).  
- Gaia Harp Enchantment: "Autumn Storm" – Nature’s fury unleashed.   
- Royal Brew Enchantment: "Volatile Brew" – Who knew a drink could be this explosive? 💥  

🔹 New Trinkets & Improvements!
- Gilded Purse: – More gold = more upgrades! 💰  
- All Warriors now have unique names (except the King… he’s still just "The King" 👑).  
- Reworked quests for better game flow.  
- Rebalanced Blacksmith upgrades & added new ones.  
- Kunais deal extra damage on impact before applying poison. 🗡️☠️  
- Monk’s Brew now has a hit sound (because audio cues matter!).  
- Tweaked VFX and fixed tons of bugs. 🛠️

⚡ Some known issues...
- When playing with 4 players, the UI displays 4 trinket slots for each player, even though only 3 can be filled.
- When playing online, the quests to unlock Secret Tincture, Prism & Persistence Rune only track progress for the host.

As we're adding so much content, features and the new mutliplayer functionality, unfortunatwely we have to wipe all existing savegames of the demo.

🎮 Please help us out and and test our new online co-op now! Your feedback will help us bugfix and fine-tune multiplayer for the full release. Join the Royal Revolt Warriors community, team up with friends, and conquer the madness together! 💪⚔️  

Thank you for your patience while we are working hard to get the release version of the game done as soon as possible!

👉 Join our Discord to share feedback and find teammates!

notes.title: Demo Patch v0.1.3
notes.notes:
Patchnotes

Greetings!

Steam Next Fest is in full swing and we love the feedback!

Today we are bringing some bug fixes and Royal Revolt Warriors to Mac.

What's New

 Royal Revolt Warriors is now available on Mac.
Polishing

 Fixed that the King sometimes couldn't destroy Barrels with the Sword in the Desert Canyon.
 Fixed a bug where closing the Settings screen with ESC would also close the Pause screen.
 Fixed a bug that sometimes caused the player grave to be displayed incorrectly
 The mouse cursor is only shown when a mouse input is connected.
If you encounter any bugs or have other feedback, please let us know!

Want to learn more? Join us on Discord! 

Your Royal Revolt Warriors Team

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
Greetings Warriors!

It’s been a little while since we got back from Gamescom, and we’ve been hard at work ever since! First off, we want to say how much we appreciated meeting so many of you in person and watching you dive into Royal Revolt Warriors with such enthusiasm.

Your energy and feedback really gave us a boost. But it wasn’t just at Gamescom, we are thrilled to see all the feedback coming in here on Steam and across our other channels. Whether it was suggestions, comments, or just sharing your excitement for the game, we’ve taken it all in.

As soon as we got back, we jumped straight into development, focusing on turning your feedback into improvements, as well as working on some exciting new ideas we've had. There's a lot going on behind the scenes and we're really looking forward to showing you some of these changes in the next demo update. 

We’re super excited about what’s coming next, and while we don’t have a specific date to share just yet, we’ll have more information on the update very soon. In the meantime, keep the feedback coming, it’s helping us shape the game in a big way!

Your Royal Revolt Warriors Team

notes.title: Royal Revolt Warriors Demo Hotfix
notes.notes:

as befits a demo, a few bugs were hidden. The following have been fixed with the latest patch:


fixed the weapon unlock on the Viking Hammer achievement (works retroactively)
properly unlock of achievements that required a weapon on lvl 8 (Tincture and Prism)

Thanks for playing the demo and let us know if there are a few more hiding. 

The Royal Revolt Warriors Team
